title: Pin important topics
notes: Moderators can now pin a topic so it stays at the top of the discussion list — pin/unpin from the topic's “⋯” menu. Pinned topics show a badge and sort first. Gated by a new “Pin / unpin topics” permission.

changelog.text: Pin topics: moderators can pin a discussion to keep it at the top of the list (topic “⋯” menu), gated by a new “Pin / unpin topics” permission.
